en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 19.  Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) asked Abul Jarud, “How far is the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.) from your house?” He replied, “If I go on a mount it takes a day to reach and if I walk, it takes a little more than that.” Imam asked, “Do you go  for  Ziyarat  every  Friday?”  He  replied,  “No,  but  I  go whenever  I  get  time.”  Imam  said,  “You  are  unjust.  If  this place  would  have  been  near  my  home  I  would  have migrated over there.”
